title: Transformer Forge
summary: A tiny forward block with tested rotary positions, SwiGLU and grouped-query attention.
implemented: Adjacent-pair RoPE with correct dimension-dependent frequencies
Causal grouped-query attention with shared KV heads
Pre-norm residual block and SwiGLU feedforward
Numerical identity, grouping and causal-prefix tests
next: Add checkpoint loading, tokenization and a full model stack
Implement backward passes and a training experiment
Compare against a trusted framework and profile kernels
limits: Toy dimensions and deterministic synthetic weights; CPU forward only. No trained model, KV cache, GPU kernels or full training runtime.

title: ProcessLens PRM
summary: A deterministic arithmetic step validator that establishes the data and feedback boundary for future process supervision.
implemented: Exact bounded rational-expression parser
Step verdicts with expected values and feedback
Commit-only-on-success dependency tracking
Tests for incorrect steps, invalid syntax and arithmetic bounds
next: Define labeled reasoning-trajectory schema and dataset loader
Train and calibrate a learned step-scoring model
Evaluate general reasoning and held-out trajectory selection
limits: Deterministic validator only; not a trained process reward model. Supports structured arithmetic expressions, not natural-language reasoning or general proofs.

title: GroupAlign GRPO
summary: Group-relative reward normalization and a clipped policy objective, verified on hand-calculated fixtures.
implemented: Group-relative advantages with a zero-variance safeguard
Sign-correct clipped importance-ratio surrogate
Sampled reference-policy KL penalty
Equal completion weighting with token means and numerical tests
next: Connect rollout generation and policy log probabilities
Add autodiff, optimizer updates and reference-model lifecycle
Run controlled alignment and reward-quality evaluations
limits: Objective evaluator only. No neural network, policy updates, rollout service, training dataset or completed alignment pipeline.

title: SpecServe
summary: The exact speculative-sampling rejection and correction rule on toy distributions, with context-dependent distribution checks.
implemented: Autoregressive draft proposals with target acceptance ratios
Positive target-minus-draft correction distribution
Bonus target token after an accepted draft block
Analytic mass identity and seeded context-dependent sampling tests
next: Integrate real draft and target model adapters
Batch target verification and handle KV-cache rollback
Measure end-to-end latency and distribution fidelity on real models
limits: Toy probability callbacks and sequential target evaluation; no real model serving, batching, streaming or measured speedup.

title: VectorGate Cache
summary: A bounded in-process cosine cache that requires exact metadata isolation before similarity lookup.
implemented: Normalized cosine lookup and exact request hits
Exact tenant, authorization and model-context namespace isolation
Entry-count capacity, LRU eviction, expiry and key replacement
Tested cache core plus a documented proxy adapter boundary
next: Build an authenticated provider-compatible network adapter
Add concurrency, byte quotas, invalidation and telemetry
Calibrate semantic hit quality on domain-specific held-out requests
limits: Single-threaded in-memory cache; not a deployed network proxy. Similarity is not proof of equivalence, and capacity bounds entry count rather than total bytes.
